target_systems: Debian and Ubuntu (/bin/sh is dash), Alpine (/bin/sh is busybox ash), macOS (/bin/sh is bash in POSIX mode)
release_assets: install.sh, lib/detect.sh and tool_<os>_<arch>.tar.gz are published side by side at the release URL
inputs: TOOL_BASE_URL and TOOL_INSTALL_DIR may be set by the user; install paths can contain spaces
